legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_11: Do not acquire, maintain or process additional identifying information solely to identify a data subject when identification is not required for the research purpose; where the controller can demonstrate it cannot identify the data subject, rights that require identification are handled in accordance with Article 11 unless the data subject provides additional information enabling identification.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_12: The controller must provide transparent information and facilitate exercise of data-subject rights through the approved privacy contact and procedure.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_15: The right of access includes confirmation whether personal data are processed, access to the personal data, a copy of the personal data undergoing processing and the contextual information required by Article 15. The reference adapter implements only the receipt-keyed respondent-record-copy component; requester authentication, confirmation and the controller-supplied processing context remain operational/controller responsibilities.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_16: Where a live response can be located by the opaque receipt and preset analytical values are inaccurate, rectification must be possible without introducing direct identifiers or mutating technical/provenance fields. The reference operation revalidates corrected profile/answer values against the frozen form definition and atomically advances integrity metadata.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_18: Where restriction applies, the record must not continue through ordinary analytical processing while the restriction is active. The reference design therefore permits storage for rights handling but excludes a held record from analytical export.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_20: Data portability applies only where the processing is based on consent or contract, is carried out by automated means and concerns data provided by the data subject. Because the lawful basis for this research is not yet approved, portability applicability must remain an explicit pre-PROD decision. If legitimate interest is finally approved as proposed, Article 20 portability is not the applicable right for that processing; if the basis changes to consent or contract, a structured machine-readable portability path must be implemented and validated before collection.
legal_design_anchors.gdpr_article_21: Where processing relies on legitimate interests and a data subject objects, processing must stop while the controller assesses the objection unless a lawful continuation ground is established. The reference design therefore applies a fail-closed analytical hold during review.

rights_applicability.decision_rule: The approved rights procedure and public notice must match the controller-approved final legal basis. A change of legal basis invalidates this draft applicability matrix until the affected rights and operational paths are re-reviewed and validated.

identification_policy.technical_receipt: The submit route returns an opaque response_id. It is not derived from name, email, IP, device, CRM or employer identity. If retained by the respondent, it may be used to locate the corresponding research-only record without creating an identity lookup table.
identification_policy.lost_receipt_rule: If the controller cannot otherwise identify the record, it must not create a new identity-linkage mechanism solely to satisfy lookup. The Article 11 position and any additional information voluntarily provided by the data subject must be assessed by the approved controller procedure.

request_channel.rule: No public collection until the determined controller publishes an operational privacy contact and request-handling route.

research_store_operations.lookup: Locate only by opaque response_id in the isolated research store; do not search CRM, optional-contact records, IP logs, user-agent logs or device data.
research_store_operations.access: After the controller applies the approved requester-authentication procedure, produce only the receipt-keyed copy of the respondent's own stored analytical record through the reviewed allowlist. The reference copy excludes storage hashes, idempotency/body digests, raw Idempotency-Key, analysis-hold state, erasure-replay controls and all other respondents. Any newly introduced stored field fails closed until disclosure is explicitly reviewed. This operation is only the personal-data-copy component; the controller must separately provide the confirmation and processing information required by Article 15.
research_store_operations.rectification: The reference rights operation locates the live record by opaque response_id, revalidates only corrected preset profile/answer values against the frozen form definition, preserves schema/research/form/version/response receipt/received_at/recruitment-channel/synthetic provenance, regenerates raw and normalized integrity hashes atomically, and advances the idempotency receipt's normalized hash while preserving the original transport body digest. This makes a delayed same-body transport retry return the corrected receipt state rather than overwrite the correction. Active restriction/objection holds remain active. If a requested correction cannot pass the frozen form/minimisation rules, the controller must use the approved alternative (including erasure/re-submission where appropriate) rather than weaken validation or collect new identity linkage.
research_store_operations.erasure: Delete the analytical row, any active analysis hold and its idempotency receipt atomically from live research storage. To prevent a delayed transport retry from recreating data that the respondent already erased, the reference adapter retains only the opaque response_id as a non-analytical replay-suppression marker. The reference adapter has no default retention and refuses an erasure that would create this marker unless a finite UTC not-after boundary is explicitly injected. At or after that boundary, replay markers are purged automatically before replay checks. The marker contains no questionnaire answers, body digest, raw Idempotency-Key, identity, contact, IP, user-agent, device, CRM or employer data. The live PROD boundary must be separately bounded and approved in the retention schedule before collection. Residual backups follow the validated non-renewing backup rotation in the retention schedule.
research_store_operations.restriction_or_objection: The reference adapter supports a receipt-keyed analysis hold. A restricted or objected record remains available for the controller's rights review but is excluded from analytical export while the hold is active. Any live implementation must preserve this fail-closed behavior and apply the controller-approved legal outcome.
research_store_operations.portability: No separate portability export is enabled in the reference adapter while the legal basis remains unresolved. If the controller selects consent or contract and Article 20 conditions are met, implement a reviewed structured machine-readable export limited to data provided by the respondent and validate it provider-bound before PROD; do not repurpose NF06 or the analytical export as an unreviewed rights endpoint.

rights_case_logging.allowed: minimum case metadata needed to demonstrate handling, decision, dates and outcome
forbidden: copying questionnaire answers into the rights-case log
adding CRM/customer identifiers to analytical records
using a rights request to build an identity-to-response registry
copying rights-case narrative into the research analysis-hold table

backup_and_deletion.rule: Live erasure must be evidenced by row/object counts and a timestamped deletion receipt. The minimal replay-suppression marker is not analytical evidence, must never enter NF06/export and requires its own controller-approved bounded lifecycle. The reference adapter proves the fail-closed shape by requiring an explicit finite boundary and providing deterministic expiry/purge behavior; it does not select the PROD duration. Provider backups may retain residual encrypted copies only for the validated pre-existing rotation and must not silently restore deleted or held records into active analysis.

required_before_prod: rights applicability matrix reconciled to the final legal basis, including portability and consent-withdrawal applicability
privacy notice updated with the final rights procedure and legal-basis-dependent rights
processor/subprocessor and provider logging/backup/deletion facts frozen

production research-only adapter supports receipt lookup, receipt-keyed access copy with reviewed field allowlist and no storage/idempotency/hold/replay internals, validated preset-value rectification with immutable technical/provenance fields, bounded analysis holds, atomic erasure and anti-replay suppression so erased data cannot be recreated by a delayed retry
if Article 20 applies under the final legal basis, a reviewed structured machine-readable portability path is implemented and provider-bound validated before collection
if consent becomes a legal basis, an operational withdrawal path is implemented and reflected in the privacy notice before collection
controller approves the requester-authentication procedure and the Article 15 confirmation/context response that supplements the reference data copy
controller approves the minimum necessary replay-marker retention bound and the live binding injects a finite UTC not-after boundary with automatic purge/deletion evidence
restriction/objection handling is operationally approved for the live adapter where applicable to the final legal basis

provider-bound TEST TWIN rights smoke proves access returns only the requester's approved record fields with no storage/internal rights state or other respondent data, rectification survives delayed transport retry without changing technical provenance, held records cannot enter analytical/NF06 export, erased records cannot be resurrected before the approved replay boundary, and replay markers expire at the approved boundary; if portability is applicable, its export is separately tested and remains NON_EVIDENCE
procedure approval reference and SHA-256 are frozen in the PROD activation manifest

test_twin.rule: Rights-flow tests use synthetic engineering fixtures only and cannot be cited as respondent evidence.
